title: vtc-server: VTCCallEndEvent on decline and cancel
description: Found while doing JMAP-8mem.7. draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00 at jmap-chat-spec 6bcd9d8 L1425: "When a ringing call is answered, declined, cancelled, or times out, the server delivers a VTCCallEndEvent to all devices that received the ring." L1443: decline on one device -> other devices get endReason "declined". vtc-server delivers answered_elsewhere (answer) and timeout (expire_ring) only; the decline path (participant.rs Effects.declined) and the initiator cancel / ringing-call end (call.rs end_reason_for Cancelled, after_leave Cancelled) deliver no VTCCallEndEvent with "declined" / "cancelled".
close_reason: Batch 11: committed and adversarially verified (or already fixed); CI green at cc87669d
